property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array and any inputs, the reference contract's transfer(...) always returns true (call completes and returns true); the mutant returns false for the same inputs, violating this guarantee.

For every non-empty _tos array and any inputs, C.transfer(...) always returns true (completes and returns true); the mutant returns false for the same inputs, so it violates this return-value guarantee.

For every input with a non-empty _tos array, the reference C.transfer never returns false (it always returns true if it doesn't revert); the mutant can return false when any external low-level call to caddress fails, so the universal rule (always-true return) is broken by some inputs where the callee reverts/fails.

For any non-empty _tos array, C.transfer always returns true (does not return false) when the call completes; the mutant returns false when _tos.length == 1, violating this universal return-value property for some inputs.
